constraints: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES turn_private.assistant_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((source_kind = 'chat_turn_event'::text) AND (event_type = 'task_status'::text) AND (status IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['accepted'::text, 'planning'::text, 'retrieving'::text, 'generating'::text, 'validating'::text, 'completed'::text, 'proposal_ready'::text, 'unavailable'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (tool IS NULL) AND (action_state IS NULL) AND (artifact_id IS NULL) AND (revision IS NULL)) OR ((source_kind = 'action_receipt'::text) AND (event_type = 'task_progress'::text) AND (status IS NULL) AND (tool IS NOT NULL) AND (tool = ANY (ARRAY['evidence.lookup'::text, 'place.read'::text, 'constraints.evaluate'::text, 'result.prepare'::text])) AND (action_state IS NOT NULL) AND (action_state = ANY (ARRAY['started'::text, 'completed'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND (artifact_id IS NULL) AND (revision IS NULL)) OR ((source_kind = 'result_event'::text) AND (event_type = ANY (ARRAY['artifact_ready'::text, 'artifact_updated'::text, 'artifact_invalidated'::text])) AND (status IS NULL) AND (tool IS NULL) AND (action_state IS NULL) AND (artifact_id IS NOT NULL) AND (revision IS NOT NULL) AND ((revision >= 1) AND (revision <= 1000)))))
FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES turn_private.assistant_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
